create_ReportBuilder: create a ReportBuilder instance with a title and optional global context for Jinja2 template rendering
add_section_ReportBuilder: add a ReportSection to a ReportBuilder instance to include it in the assembled HTML report
build_ReportBuilder: build a complete HTML report string from all added ReportSection instances using Jinja2 templates
save_ReportBuilder: save a built HTML report to a file path on disk
review_ReportBuilder: review the ReportBuilder class that assembles report sections into a complete HTML report using Jinja2
